preconditions.description: The integer n is within the valid range [1, 100000].
The permutation list has exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in permutation)
preconditions.description: Every element in the permutation is an integer between 1 and n.
The permutation contains each integer from 1 to n exactly once.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'ambiguous\n' if permutation == [permutation[i-1] for i in permutation] else 'not ambiguous\n'
postconditions.description: The output is 'ambiguous' if the permutation is equal to its inverse permutation, otherwise 'not ambiguous'.
